requirements.title: The web application shall write the full habit dataset to localStorage immediately after any habit mutation

vision.paraphrase: Immediate writes to localStorage fulfill the no-data-loss goal, ensuring every user action is persisted without a save button, loading state, or network round-trip.
Every mutation triggers an immediate synchronous write to localStorage, which is the sole persistence layer and the sole system of record for the application.

conops.paraphrase: After the user adds a habit, the app immediately persists the new record to localStorage, making it durable across browser sessions.

requirements.title: The web application shall restore the full habit list from localStorage on reload with no data loss

vision.paraphrase: Persistent habit data across reloads fulfills the no-data-loss goal, enabling users to close the browser mid-session and resume exactly where they left off.
Scenario 6 describes a user reopening the browser and seeing their habits, streaks, and completion states unchanged, which this requirement enables.

conops.paraphrase: On app startup, the system reads the full habit dataset from localStorage, deserializing and restoring all habit names, streaks, and completion states.

requirements.title: The web application shall initialize an empty habit list without error when no prior data exists

vision.paraphrase: Graceful initialization on first visit supports zero-friction habit creation by immediately presenting the user with the empty-state prompt and add-habit input.

conops.paraphrase: When a new user opens the app for the first time, localStorage contains no data; the app gracefully initializes an empty habit list and shows the empty-state guidance.

requirements.title: The web application shall perform all habit operations without issuing any network requests

vision.paraphrase: No backend dependency is achieved by ensuring the app is fully functional offline, with all operations confined to client-side in-memory and localStorage state.
The browser tab is the entire runtime, and every operation is synchronous and local; there are no background processes, polling, or network calls.

conops.paraphrase: The entire user journey — adding, checking off, archiving, and unarchiving habits — operates entirely within the browser with zero external dependencies.
